timeframe: event-time public trades transformed into completed one-second trade bars and causally confirmed five-second liquidity structure
license_or_terms: Bybit public-data and exchange terms apply.
causal_availability: Each trade is usable only at its exchange timestamp. A one-second trade bar is available only after the second completes. A five-second pivot becomes liquidity only after its right-side span completes. The first inside-to-outside crossing after confirmation defines the sweep. Paired-market non-raid state and all confirmation/FVG features use only completed observations. Entry occurs at the first observed trade no earlier than decision time plus 100ms, or after a later completed FVG-midpoint mitigation followed by the same latency. No future trade, unfinished bar, pre-confirmation pivot, missing-price imputation or favorable source-boundary mark is used.
